record.original_question: Do there exist two Connes embeddable non-Gamma II_1 factors that are not elementarily equivalent? More strongly, are there continuum many pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent non-Gamma factors of this kind?

evidence.quote: Problem 16. Does there exist a pair of Connes embeddable non Gamma factors that are not elementarily equivalent? Does there exist continuum many non Gamma factors that are pairwise not elementarily equivalent?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A II$_1$ factor is a separable, infinite-dimensional von Neumann algebra $M$ with trivial center and a (necessarily unique) faithful normal tracial state $\tau$. Such a factor $M$ is said to have property Gamma if there exists a sequence of unitaries $(u_n)$ in $M$ with $\tau(u_n)=0$ for all $n$ such that $\|u_n x - x u_n\|_2 \to 0$ for every $x \in M$, where $\|y\|_2 = \tau(y^*y)^{1/2}$. A II$_1$ factor $M$ is Connes embeddable if it embeds (as a unital tracial von Neumann algebra) into an ultrapower $R^{\mathcal U}$ of the hyperfinite II$_1$ factor $R$ for some free ultrafilter $\mathcal U$ on $\mathbb N$. Two II$_1$ factors $M_1$ and $M_2$ are called elementarily equivalent if they satisfy the same sentences in the continuous first-order language of tracial von Neumann algebras (equivalently, $M_1^{\mathcal U} \cong M_2^{\mathcal U}$ for some, hence any, free ultrafilter $\mathcal U$ on a sufficiently saturated index set).

(a) Do there exist two Connes embeddable II$_1$ factors, both without property Gamma, that are not elementarily equivalent?

(b) Does there exist a family $\{M_i\}_{i \in I}$ of cardinality $|I| = 2^{\aleph_0}$ consisting of Connes embeddable II$_1$ factors without property Gamma such that $M_i$ and $M_j$ are not elementarily equivalent whenever $i \neq j$?
artifact.category_tag: II_1 factors and continuous model theory
artifact.status_search_result: Part (a) appears to be solved: an explicit construction by Chifan–Ioana–Kunnawalkam Elayavalli (published in GAFA, 2023) produces a separable II$_1$ factor without property Gamma that is not elementarily equivalent to any free group factor $L(\mathbb F_n)$, providing two non-elementarily-equivalent Connes embeddable non-Gamma II$_1$ factors. Part (b), asking for continuum many pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent Connes embeddable non-Gamma factors, does not appear to be established in the literature and seems to remain open.

status_evidence.title: An exotic II_1 factor without property Gamma
status_evidence.snippet: A separable II_1 factor is constructed which does not have property Gamma and is not elementarily equivalent to L(F_n) for any 2 ≤ n ≤ ∞.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the first explicit pair of non-elementarily equivalent non-Gamma II_1 factors (both Connes embeddable), settling part (a).

status_evidence.title: An exotic II_1 factor without property Gamma (preprint)
status_evidence.snippet: First explicit example of a II_1 factor without property Gamma that is not elementarily equivalent to any ultraproduct of matrix algebras.
status_evidence.claim: The constructed factor is Connes embeddable and non-Gamma, not elementarily equivalent to free group factors.
